title: Bnos Yisroel Shidduch Initiative
body:
The Bnos Yisroel Shidduch Initiative is designed to raise awareness that everyone can play a role in making shidduchim. By thinking intentionally about the people you know, you can help create opportunities that may otherwise never happen. As educators and staff members, you have meaningful insight into our talmidos and are often in a unique position to come up with ideas.

To recognize the time, thought, and effort involved, Bnos Yisroel offers a $100 incentive for each shidduch you facilitate that results in a first date involving a Bnos Yisroel alumna or staff member.

To report a shidduch you thought of that has resulted in a first date, use this link:

Bnos Yisroel Shidduch Match Submission

All information is handled with discretion and used for internal purposes only.
